review.method: Full English drafts, then manual meaning-preserving compression and native gameplay font measurements across all eight gameplay bundles.

changelog: 0.1.37: Reviewed all six long objective strings and provided compact English preserving counts, conditions, and slash separators. Sixth reviewed against supplied English; original Japanese unavailable.

rows.source: 輸送艦が領域を離脱／母艦の撃沈
rows.full_en: The transport ship leaves the area / The mothership is sunk
rows.notes: Tpt abbreviates transport ship; M'ship abbreviates mothership. Explicitly retains leaving the area and sinking, with the existing slash separator.

rows.source: 友軍部隊が４つ壊滅／母艦の撃沈
rows.full_en: Four allied units are destroyed / The mothership is sunk
rows.notes: Retains four, allied affiliation, units, unit loss, and mothership sinking. Ally is an attributive noun meaning allied here; units remain explicit so four does not refer to individual pilots. Lost is the established defeat-condition wording for destroyed units. M'ship abbreviates mothership.

rows.full_en: Seven enemy warships leave the area
rows.notes: Retains seven, enemy affiliation, warship type, and departure from the area. Omits only the article before area.

rows.source: 敵の防衛ライン突破阻止
rows.old: Stop enemies breaching the defense line
rows.full_en: Prevent enemies from breaking through the defense line
rows.notes: Nominalizes the enemy action while retaining prevention of an enemy breach of the defense line. Defense-line qualifies breach, not enemy affiliation.

rows.source: 一定時間、全拠点を防衛
rows.old: Defend all bases for the set time
rows.full_en: Defend all bases for the specified time
rows.en: Defend all bases for set time
rows.notes: Retains defense of every base for the specified duration. Omits only the article before set time.

rows.source: Destroy all enemies attacking the city
rows.source_provenance: Existing active mission objective, text ID 1; original Japanese not retrieved.
rows.old: Destroy all enemies attacking the city
rows.full_en: Destroy all enemies attacking the city
rows.notes: Foes means enemies; retains destruction of all enemies engaged in attacking the city. Omits only the article before city. Review is against the supplied existing English because original Japanese is unavailable.
